title.narrative: Enhancing all-inclusive and Digitalized Coffee value chain in Kenya

description.narrative:
The Enhanced All-Inclusive and Sustainable Coffee Value Chain in Kenya project, led by the National Coffee Cooperative Union Limited (NACCU) with support from We Effect, will run from 2025-2028. Its overall objective is to strengthen farmers' voice and recognition, improve sustainable incomes, and expand access to modern technologies across Kenya's coffee value chain. The project aims to achieve a more inclusive and sustainable sector by working through NACCU's affiliate unions. Six unions—Bungoma, Trans Nzoia, West Pokot, Uasin Gishu, Meru South, and Kirinyaga—representing about 120,000 coffee farmers, will be the primary beneficiaries. The project addresses key challenges including farmers' limited voice in industry decision-making, the high cost and difficulty of adopting traceability systems, the need for geo-location data, compliance with new EU regulations, and the limited role and benefits accruing to women in the value chain. Implementation strategies include partnerships and networks, advocacy forums with county and national authorities, research and knowledge sharing, institutional capacity building, resource mobilization, gender-transformative actions, community engagement, value addition, and improved access to market information.
Expected outcomes include stronger, more efficient unions; enhanced advocacy; improved financial access; greater women's participation; expanded profitable markets; and adoption of climate-smart, modern farming practices. Ultimately, the project aims to deliver empowered farmers with better incomes, stronger recognition, and improved technological access.
